Anima Ability @UUID[Compendium.immortal-ardor.spells.jqFNcI2MnhT5XRqJ]{Anima Ability: Raging Thrust}

You rush forward in a gallop, and rearing up, you gore your target with a horn. Stride up to your speed and make an Anima Strike. If the attack hits, you deal an additional 1d8 damage, and the target needs to make a Reflex saving throw or become knocked prone.

@UUID[Compendium.immortal-ardor.spells.2O1tY2ers0bB3MU8]{Spell Effect: Raging Thrust}

Heightened (8th) Increase the additional damage to 2d8.
